verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client with chat-with-inbox features, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows Zero exposing its own MCP server (ZeroMCP) with email and label tools for other clients to call. That is the server role and earns no credit for plugging external MCP servers into Zero; nothing in the pack shows Zero consuming third-party MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
